No technology fixes bad design, it can only mitigate it.","howIWork":["Designs start as written proposals with the decisions recorded.","Changes land with tests and a CI gate.","Every production bug gets a post-mortem, including fixes that had to be reverted.","AI-assisted development is part of the daily workflow; every diff is read before it lands.","Once a pipeline or mechanism works, it is handed over with the reasoning written down, so the knowledge lives in the team, not in one person."],"yearsOfExperience":"20+","location":"Novi Sad, Vojvodina, Serbia","focus":["identity & access (OAuth 1.0a / OAuth2 / OpenID Connect, Keycloak, consents & SCA)","security","AI & agent integration (MCP)","traceability & auditability","API platforms & governance (REST, OpenAPI, versioning)","open banking (PSD2, Berlin Group, UK Open Banking)"],"principles":["No technology fixes bad design, it can only mitigate it.","Start with the design, then explain it simply enough that it can be questioned.","Identity says who acted, security says what they may do, traceability says what actually happened."],"currentRole":{"title":"Lead Software Developer","company":"TESOBE - Technical Solutions Berlin","since":"2017-05","type":"contract, remote"},"writes":{"what":"Short, practical explainers on software and security: how a mechanism works, why it exists, what to do with it.","where":"https://constantine2nd.github.io/"},"availability":{"booking":"https://calendar.app.google/NN4H7bCnNWssxNp38","timezone":"Europe/Belgrade","workOverlap":"~4h daily overlap with US Eastern","status":"Open to senior engineering and architecture roles","note":"Fully remote from Serbia since 2017; best reached by e-mail."},"links":{"email":"marko.milic@yahoo.com","linkedin":"https://www.linkedin.com/in/marko-milić-4332a81b9","github":"https://github.com/constantine2nd","about":"https://constantine2nd.github.io/about/","blog":"https://constantine2nd.github.io/"}}
